title: previewBinding
responsibility: Validates a visual unit preview against its declared screenshot state and viewport.

inputs.name: previewBinding.unit
inputs.description: Visual unit and its optional declared scenario, state and viewport selection.

inputs.name: previewBinding.scenarios
inputs.description: Selected-revision scenarios against which the preview slot and unit attribution are validated.

outputs.name: issues
outputs.description: Empty when no preview is declared or its own required screenshot state and viewport exist; otherwise readable validation problems.
